strategies.label: Single agent
strategies.description: One agent, one context, the full toolset. It reads the task, acts, and answers in a single session with no separate planning, review or delegation step. This is the control condition the other four architectures are measured against: every extra phase they add has to earn its cost and latency back in score.

tasks.title: HTTP 301 vs 308
tasks.prompt:
What is the difference between HTTP status codes 301 and 308? Explain what each one means, how a client is expected to treat the request method and body when following each, whether each is cacheable, and where each is specified.

Research this with the provided web tools and write a complete, self-contained answer. Cite the URL of every source you rely on.
tasks.policy:
Research rules:
- The `search` and `fetch_page` tools are your only access to the web. Any other browsing tool is unavailable.
- Search snippets are previews, not sources. Open a page with `fetch_page` before relying on what it says.
- Cite the URL of every source you rely on, inline, next to the claim it supports.
- Never cite a URL you did not open with `fetch_page`. A citation to an unopened page is scored as a fabrication.
- When sources disagree, say so explicitly and attribute each position, instead of silently picking one.
- State what the sources say. Do not pad the answer with unsupported general knowledge.
